doc_friction.issue: parseXmlTree's attribute regex is ASCII-only, so CFDI's `Año` attribute reads as `o`; cfdi-xml.mjs has its own Unicode-aware reader rather than changing the shared one under every other format.

The examples job runs every file in examples/ through the Python UBL CLI and skips national formats by a filename list in the workflow (control plane), so a new national-format example fails CI unless the workflow changes. The CFDI sample lives in fixtures/ instead.
